name: direction-aware-hover
title: Direction Aware Hover
blurb: Image and text slide based on which edge you hover from.
description: Card with background image that detects which border (top/bottom/left/right) the mouse enters from and animates the image and overlay text in opposite directions.
use_when: Image cards where hover direction should add visual feedback and detail to the interaction.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces — direction detection requires hover events and pointer position.
a11y: Detects mouse entry direction with no keyboard fallback. Image renders with empty alt text.
